title: The Battle of Verdun begins
summary: German forces opened a massive bombardment and offensive against French positions around Verdun, starting a ten-month battle that cost about 700,000 casualties.
reason: German commander Erich von Falkenhayn aimed to bleed the French army white at a place it would not abandon.
significance: It became the longest battle of World War I and a lasting symbol of French resolve and of the war's futility.
